service_signature_method.multiset: Restart FNV offset for each accepted request, sum request hashes modulo2**64. Not a cryptographic proof; exact-byte goldens and per-line occurrence assertions remain mandatory.
service_signature_method.ordered_write: Continuous FNV over write tuples only. Data lines32..used-16 ascending, then descriptor0,16.
service_signature_method.request_tuple: direction,address,assumed_response_latency, followed only for writes by four zero-extended32bit payload words in ascending byte order
service_signature_method.word_encoding: Every word eight bytes little endian; all operations modulo 2**64. Directions write1/read0; address is byte address.

timestamp_contract.bounded_read_ownership: One immutable offered/accepted needed-line read at a time, filling an existing segment cache only after matching successful ACK. No added payload cache. Current tile/raw scalar remains immutable during output hold. Offered or accepted prefetch drains before demand reader continues. Full next-tile merging remains unimplemented.
timestamp_contract.bounded_write_ownership: One immutable offered/accepted16B slot and one16B assembler, plus existing scalar pending record. At most1accepted physical request; seal waits for physical ACK drainage; header writes retain sequential ACK gating.
timestamp_contract.clock: Single simulated decoder clock; no achieved target frequency or physical controller calibration
timestamp_contract.current_endpoint: One BR88 residual chunk through packed scratch and dense coefficient completion
timestamp_contract.edge_convention: Start edge excluded. Subsequent running rising edges are numbered from1. Histograms sample the pre-edge FSM state. Timestamps identify the accepting/observing edge, not wall-clock milliseconds.

future_product_fences.frame_first_byte_to_validated_publicatio: Not implemented; future full-frame timestamp pair
future_product_fences.frame_packet_complete_to_validated_publi: Not implemented; primary future strictly-under10ms fence
future_product_fences.sustained_frame_service: Distinct source releases, output identities and queue occupancy over hardware60/600second runs; a short last-byte fence cannot hide unsustainable service

timestamp_contract.interpretation: The packet and scratch histograms each partition the same active interval; do not add them together. Stall/event counters overlap those partitions. State occupancy is not a causal promise that all its cycles can be removed. A memory service hash matches ordered requests, write payloads and assumed ACK delay, excluding epoch tags and absolute cycle.

read_prefetch_counter_semantics.physical_acks: Matching successful physical prefetch read responses
read_prefetch_counter_semantics.uses: First DC/AC extraction from each ACK-prefetched line
